messages:
maya: Quick check — RFC review for 'KV-cache heuristics' is up. Need to slot authors and finalize agenda. Proposed Wed 10:00 PDT. Authors: @kevin + @sophia. Reviewers suggested: @aj, @oliver. Can authors confirm they can present? Also please drop pre-read (design + perf figs) by EOD Tue so reviewers can skim.

kevin: I can present at 10, but may need ~10m to set up demo. Could swap with Sophia if she needs more time. Draft here: https://r.infr/kv-cache-rfc (will add perf bits tonight).

sophia: 10 works for me but prefer to go first. My pre-read will be up by this evening. I'll include the perf-run summary and a short migration checklist.

aj: +1 for 10. Can you add a TL;DR at top for faster skimming? I'll take reviewer slot A. :thumbsup:

oliver: 10 okay. If we need to shuffle I can move to 11:15. Also suggest agenda order: 1) 5m TL;DR & goals 2) 15m design walkthrough 3) 10m perf + benchmarks 4) 15m Q&A/rollout plan. Keep to 45m total.

maya: That agenda looks good. Kevin — can you make a 3-slide perf summary? Sophia — do you want 10m for demo or 5m + deeper doc link?

kevin: I'll do 3 slides. Demo 5m + deeper link sounds right.

sophia: 5m demo + doc link is fine. I'll add a short checklist for compatibility (backpressure, shard keys).

calendar-bot: Event created: 'RFC: KV-cache heuristics' Wed 10:00–10:45 PDT. Attendees: maya, kevin, sophia, aj, oliver. (conference link added)

maya: Reminder — pre-reads due by 23:59 PDT Tue. If you can't make 10, reply with alt times. Otherwise I'll lock agenda tomorrow noon and post final order.

aj: tiny nit — can we add a brief compatibility checklist in pre-read (grpc backpressure, shard keys)? I'll mark in doc.

kevin: noted, adding checklist and perf numbers.

deploy-bot: FYI: canary infra reserved 09:30–12:00 Wed per ops window. :white_check_mark:

oliver: all set from my side. Thanks!

maya: Thanks everyone — locking agenda at 12:00 PDT tomorrow unless objections.
